retired_records.question_text:
Original Practice Question — Six people E, B, F, D, A, C were born in six different years: 1984, 1987, 1990, 1993, 1996, 1999. Each year is assigned to one person. Shared clues: E was born earlier than B. B was born earlier than F. F was born earlier than D. D was born earlier than A. A was born earlier than C.

Question: In which year was A born?
retired_records.explanation: The clues force the birth-year order E → B → F → D → A → C from earliest to latest. Therefore A corresponds to 1996.
